name: Jesse Middleton
description: WeWork pioneer turned maverick VC at Flybridge. After his tenure as a founding team member at WeWork, Jesse made the transition to venture capital and has backed over fifty pre-seed and seed stage companies as an angel investor and GP at Flybridge. His investment focus centers on the future of work, emphasizing areas such as creativity, culture, collaboration, and communication.
